purpose: Bounded extension routes plus explicit reviewed replacements for canonical onchain Market Data routes. Base v0.15 remains byte-stable; route overrides are fail-closed and may only target existing canonical asset ids.

route.provenance: Official Olas OLAS token and protocol-owned OLAS/WETH Uniswap V2 pair. Read-only cumulative-price historical TWAP from two block-pinned pair states using a 60-block recent-history window proven live on the standard public Ethereum RPC fabric; composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No updatePrice transaction, keeper dependency, reserve spot price, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

OVER official Ethereum OVR token. Read-only Uniswap V3 OVR/WETH 1% pool discovered through the canonical Ethereum Uniswap V3 factory, priced by observe()-based 30-minute TWAP and composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No slot0 spot-price authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Beam official Ethereum BEAM token. Read-only canonical Uniswap V3 Factory-discovered BEAM/WETH 1% pool geometric 30-minute observe() TWAP, live-proven with positive active liquidity and sub-1% divergence, composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. No slot0 spot-price authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Canonical multichain elizaOS token on BNB Chain priced from the PancakeSwap V3 elizaOS/USDC 0.25% pool. Preferred pricing is an observe()-based 5-minute geometric TWAP; if and only if the pool returns Uniswap V3 OLD because retained observation history is shorter, the resolver retries explicitly bounded shorter observe() windows 180s, 120s, then 60s and uses the longest successful window. Token and quote decimals are read onchain each cycle. USDC/USD is independently read from the BNB Chain Chainlink Data Feed and freshness/integrity checked; no hardcoded stablecoin peg, slot0 spot authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Yield Basis YB token priced from the primary YB/crvUSD Curve trading venue. Uses block-pinned Curve price_oracle() EMA for crvUSD per YB, composed with same-cycle Ethereum Chainlink crvUSD/USD with round-integrity and freshness checks. Live discovery proved the Curve route within 0.04% of canonical while alternative YB/USDC and YB/USDT V3 pools were materially off-market. Replaces the intermittently OLD YB/WETH Uniswap V3 history route. No Curve spot quote, hardcoded stablecoin peg, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Official MODE token on Mode Mainnet and official Velodrome Superchain V2 PoolFactory on chain 34443. Factory-discovered MODE/WETH volatile pool uses Velodrome observation TWAP pinned to the discovery block and composes with same-cycle ETH/USD. Replaces stale Pyth stored-state dependency; no updater, spot-price authority, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Verified Curve Twocrypto FXN/ETH pool. Transaction evidence establishes sold_id=1 as FXN and bought_id=0 as ETH/WETH, matching coin0=WETH and coin1=FXN for the existing Curve EMA adapter. Uses block-pinned price_oracle() EMA composed with same-cycle ETH/USD. Replaces the intermittent Uniswap V3 OLD observation-history failure; no spot-price authority, updater dependency, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.

Tether Gold XAUT token-market price from the long-lived high-liquidity Ethereum Uniswap V3 XAUT/USDT 0.05% pool (factory-discovered pool 0x6546055f46e866a4b9a4a13e81273e3152bae5da). Uses observe()-based 30-minute geometric TWAP with bounded OLD-only fallback to 15m/10m/5m. USDT/USD is independently read from the Ethereum Chainlink Data Feed with freshness/integrity checks. This deliberately replaces the previous XAU/USD backing-reference proxy so canonical XAUT pricing reflects the traded token market rather than underlying-gold reference semantics. No spot-price authority, hardcoded stablecoin peg, paid RPC, signing, or execution authority.
